title: Black Opal Consultants IPO Details
intro:
Black Opal Consultants IPO is a book build issue of ₹55.08 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 22.38 lakh shares aggregating to ₹44.09 crores and offer for sale of 5.58 lakh shares aggregating to ₹10.99 crores.

Black Opal Consultants IPO opens for subscription on Sep 29, 2026 and closes on Oct 1, 2026. The allotment for the Black Opal Consultants IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 5, 2026. Black Opal Consultants IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 7, 2026.

Black Opal Consultants IPO is set issue price band at ₹185 to ₹197 per share. The lot size for an application is 600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,36,400 (1,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (1,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,54,600.

Khambatta Securities Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Skyline Financial Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Share India Securities Ltd.

Refer to Black Opal Consultants IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2020, Black Opal Consultants Limited works with well-known real estate developers such as Gaurs Group, SKA, Galaxy, Shapoorji Pallonji, Max Estates, and M3M to market and sell their residential and commercial projects. The Company signs exclusive or semi-exclusive sales rights to market and sell specific units within a project in return for brokerage income. The Company also works with its Group Entities, such as Aurika Homes Private Limited to market and sell Aurika Homes’ projects in return for brokerage income. This helps strengthen group synergies and enhances business growth.

The Company works in both residential and commercial segments, mainly focusing on new and under-construction properties. It supports developers in selling their projects and helps customers buy properties. Black Opal has a network of more than 200 brokers, which helps expand its reach. It also uses platforms like Facebook and Google for marketing.
Black Opal has entered the development business through Aurika Developers LLP. Its first project, “Veda” , is a commercial and hospitality project in Darshan Nagar, Ayodhya.
strengths: In-depth Asset & Project Management Expertise and Proven Track Record in Project Sales

faqs.question: How to apply in Black Opal Consultants IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Black Opal Consultants IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Black Opal Consultants IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Black Opal Consultants IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Black Opal Consultants IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: The Black Opal Consultants IPO opens on Tue, Sep 29, 2026 and closes on Thu, Oct 1, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Black Opal Consultants IPO?
faqs.answer: Black Opal Consultants IPO lot size is 600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,36,400 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Black Opal Consultants IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Black Opal Consultants IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Black Opal Consultants IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Black Opal Consultants IPO will be done on Monday, October 5, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Oct 6, 2026 . Check the Black Opal Consultants IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Black Opal Consultants IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Oct 7, 2026 .
